exposure: pregnancy in a shorter interval than two years
cohort: The study included 293 pregnant women with high-risk pregnancies who were followed up at an outpatient clinic in Batman province, Turkiye, between March 2017 and January 2019.
finding: Anemia, multiple pregnancy, and intrauterine fertilization significantly increase the risk of preterm labor.
mod_finding: Caesarean section birth rates were significantly higher among pregnant women who experienced preterm labor compared to those who gave birth at term.
